_comment: FLUX.1 — every FLUX.1-shaped file William put in flux_models\ (fp8 unets, bf16 unets cast to fp8 on load, an all-in-one 8x8 checkpoint via CheckpointLoaderSimple, a .gguf via the ComfyUI-GGUF node) x (no LoRA + every FLUX.1 LoRA found: RPGmaps_v5, RPGv6, bbeam_comic, FluxDFaeTasticDetails) on the sixteen sdxl_v1 prompts, plus the painted-cinematic style pictures with no LoRA. Steps 4 for 'schnell' names else 20 (24 for de-distilled, with cfg 3.5); guidance 3.5. Unet-only files need clip_l + t5xxl + ae in models\text_encoders / models\vae (pull_flux.bat fetches them); the all-in-one file needs nothing. LICENCE: FLUX.1 dev and its fine-tunes are non-commercial — bake-off only; prov.json records it. LoRA columns run on the all-in-one 'marduk191' dev checkpoint only (the reference model); the other FLUX.1 files run without LoRAs.
